2159  // ============================================================================================
2160  // Expected states on region state transition.
2161  // Notice that there is expected states for transiting to OPENING state, this is because SCP.
2162  // See the comments in regionOpening method for more details.
2163  // ============================================================================================
2164  private static final State[] STATES_EXPECTED_ON_OPEN = { State.OPENING, // Normal case
2165    State.OPEN // Retrying
2166  };
2167
2168  private static final State[] STATES_EXPECTED_ON_CLOSING = { State.OPEN, // Normal case
2169    State.CLOSING, // Retrying
2170    State.SPLITTING, // Offline the split parent
2171    State.MERGING // Offline the merge parents
2172  };
2173
2174  private static final State[] STATES_EXPECTED_ON_CLOSED = { State.CLOSING, // Normal case
2175    State.CLOSED // Retrying
2176  };
2177
2178  // This is for manually scheduled region assign, can add other states later if we find out other
2179  // usages
2180  private static final State[] STATES_EXPECTED_ON_ASSIGN = { State.CLOSED, State.OFFLINE };
2181
2182  // We only allow unassign or move a region which is in OPEN state.
2183  private static final State[] STATES_EXPECTED_ON_UNASSIGN_OR_MOVE = { State.OPEN };
2184
2185  // ============================================================================================
2186  // Region Status update
2187  // Should only be called in TransitRegionStateProcedure(and related procedures), as the locking
2188  // and pre-assumptions are very tricky.
2189  // ============================================================================================
2190  private CompletableFuture<Void> transitStateAndUpdate(RegionStateNode regionNode,
2191    RegionState.State newState, RegionState.State... expectedStates) {
2192    RegionState.State state = regionNode.getState();
2193    try {
2194      regionNode.transitionState(newState, expectedStates);
2195    } catch (UnexpectedStateException e) {
2196      return FutureUtils.failedFuture(e);
2197    }
2198    CompletableFuture<Void> future = regionStateStore.updateRegionLocation(regionNode);
2199    FutureUtils.addListener(future, (r, e) -> {
2200      if (e != null) {
2201        // revert
2202        regionNode.setState(state);
2203      } else {
2204        regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(regionNode);
2205      }
2206    });
2207    return future;
2208  }
2209
2210  // should be called within the synchronized block of RegionStateNode
2211  CompletableFuture<Void> regionOpening(RegionStateNode regionNode) {
2212    // As in SCP, for performance reason, there is no TRSP attached with this region, we will not
2213    // update the region state, which means that the region could be in any state when we want to
2214    // assign it after a RS crash. So here we do not pass the expectedStates parameter.
2215    return transitStateAndUpdate(regionNode, State.OPENING).thenAccept(r -> {
2216      ServerStateNode serverNode = regionStates.getServerNode(regionNode.getRegionLocation());
2217      // Here the server node could be null. For example, we want to assign the region to a given
2218      // region server and it crashes, and it is the region server which holds hbase:meta, then the
2219      // above transitStateAndUpdate call will never succeed until we finishes the SCP for it. But
2220      // after the SCP finishes, the server node will be removed, so when we arrive there, the
2221      // server
2222      // node will be null. This is not a big problem if we skip adding it, as later we will fail to
2223      // execute the remote procedure on the region server and then try to assign to another region
2224      // server
2225      if (serverNode != null) {
2226        serverNode.addRegion(regionNode);
2227      }
2228      // update the operation count metrics
2229      metrics.incrementOperationCounter();
2230    });
2231  }
2232
2233  // should be called under the RegionStateNode lock
2234  // The parameter 'giveUp' means whether we will try to open the region again, if it is true, then
2235  // we will persist the FAILED_OPEN state into hbase:meta.
2236  CompletableFuture<Void> regionFailedOpen(RegionStateNode regionNode, boolean giveUp) {
2237    RegionState.State state = regionNode.getState();
2238    ServerName regionLocation = regionNode.getRegionLocation();
2239    if (!giveUp) {
2240      if (regionLocation != null) {
2241        regionStates.removeRegionFromServer(regionLocation, regionNode);
2242      }
2243      return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
2244    }
2245    regionNode.setState(State.FAILED_OPEN);
2246    regionNode.setRegionLocation(null);
2247    CompletableFuture<Void> future = regionStateStore.updateRegionLocation(regionNode);
2248    FutureUtils.addListener(future, (r, e) -> {
2249      if (e == null) {
2250        if (regionLocation != null) {
2251          regionStates.removeRegionFromServer(regionLocation, regionNode);
2252        }
2253        regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(regionNode);
2254      } else {
2255        // revert
2256        regionNode.setState(state);
2257        regionNode.setRegionLocation(regionLocation);
2258      }
2259    });
2260    return future;
2261  }
2262
2263  // should be called under the RegionStateNode lock
2264  CompletableFuture<Void> regionClosing(RegionStateNode regionNode) {
2265    return transitStateAndUpdate(regionNode, State.CLOSING, STATES_EXPECTED_ON_CLOSING)
2266      .thenAccept(r -> {
2267        RegionInfo hri = regionNode.getRegionInfo();
2268        // Set meta has not initialized early. so people trying to create/edit tables will wait
2269        if (isMetaRegion(hri)) {
2270          setMetaAssigned(hri, false);
2271        }
2272        // update the operation count metrics
2273        metrics.incrementOperationCounter();
2274      });
2275  }
2276
2277  // for open and close, they will first be persist to the procedure store in
2278  // RegionRemoteProcedureBase. So here we will first change the in memory state as it is considered
2279  // as succeeded if the persistence to procedure store is succeeded, and then when the
2280  // RegionRemoteProcedureBase is woken up, we will persist the RegionStateNode to hbase:meta.
2281
2282  // should be called under the RegionStateNode lock
2283  void regionOpenedWithoutPersistingToMeta(RegionStateNode regionNode)
2284    throws UnexpectedStateException {
2285    regionNode.transitionState(State.OPEN, STATES_EXPECTED_ON_OPEN);
2286    RegionInfo regionInfo = regionNode.getRegionInfo();
2287    regionStates.addRegionToServer(regionNode);
2288    regionStates.removeFromFailedOpen(regionInfo);
2289  }
2290
2291  // should be called under the RegionStateNode lock
2292  void regionClosedWithoutPersistingToMeta(RegionStateNode regionNode)
2293    throws UnexpectedStateException {
2294    ServerName regionLocation = regionNode.getRegionLocation();
2295    regionNode.transitionState(State.CLOSED, STATES_EXPECTED_ON_CLOSED);
2296    regionNode.setRegionLocation(null);
2297    if (regionLocation != null) {
2298      regionNode.setLastHost(regionLocation);
2299      regionStates.removeRegionFromServer(regionLocation, regionNode);
2300    }
2301  }
2302
2303  // should be called under the RegionStateNode lock
2304  CompletableFuture<Void> persistToMeta(RegionStateNode regionNode) {
2305    return regionStateStore.updateRegionLocation(regionNode).thenAccept(r -> {
2306      RegionInfo regionInfo = regionNode.getRegionInfo();
2307      if (isMetaRegion(regionInfo) && regionNode.getState() == State.OPEN) {
2308        // Usually we'd set a table ENABLED at this stage but hbase:meta is ALWAYs enabled, it
2309        // can't be disabled -- so skip the RPC (besides... enabled is managed by TableStateManager
2310        // which is backed by hbase:meta... Avoid setting ENABLED to avoid having to update state
2311        // on table that contains state.
2312        setMetaAssigned(regionInfo, true);
2313      }
2314      regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(regionNode);
2315    });
2316  }
2317
2318  // should be called under the RegionStateNode lock
2319  // for SCP
2320  public CompletableFuture<Void> regionClosedAbnormally(RegionStateNode regionNode) {
2321    RegionState.State state = regionNode.getState();
2322    ServerName regionLocation = regionNode.getRegionLocation();
2323    regionNode.setState(State.ABNORMALLY_CLOSED);
2324    regionNode.setRegionLocation(null);
2325    CompletableFuture<Void> future = regionStateStore.updateRegionLocation(regionNode);
2326    FutureUtils.addListener(future, (r, e) -> {
2327      if (e == null) {
2328        if (regionLocation != null) {
2329          regionNode.setLastHost(regionLocation);
2330          regionStates.removeRegionFromServer(regionLocation, regionNode);
2331        }
2332        regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(regionNode);
2333      } else {
2334        // revert
2335        regionNode.setState(state);
2336        regionNode.setRegionLocation(regionLocation);
2337      }
2338    });
2339    return future;
2340  }

2343  // The above methods can only be called in TransitRegionStateProcedure(and related procedures)

2346  // As soon as a server a crashed, region hosting on that are un-available, this method helps to
2347  // track those un-available regions. This method can only be called from ServerCrashProcedure.
2348  public void markRegionsAsCrashed(List<RegionInfo> regionsOnCrashedServer,
2349    ServerCrashProcedure scp) {
2350    ServerName crashedServerName = scp.getServerName();
2351    assert crashedServerName != null;
2352    for (RegionInfo regionInfo : regionsOnCrashedServer) {
2353      RegionStateNode node = regionStates.getOrCreateRegionStateNode(regionInfo);
2354      if (crashedServerName.equals(node.getRegionLocation())) {
2355        node.crashed(scp.getSubmittedTime());
2356        regionInTransitionTracker.regionCrashed(node);
2357      } else {
2358        LOG.warn("Region {} should be on crashed region server {} but is recorded on {}",
2359          regionInfo, crashedServerName, node.getRegionLocation());
2360      }
2361    }
2362  }
2363
2364  public void markRegionAsSplit(final RegionInfo parent, final ServerName serverName,
2365    final RegionInfo daughterA, final RegionInfo daughterB) throws IOException {
2366    // Update hbase:meta. Parent will be marked offline and split up in hbase:meta.
2367    // The parent stays in regionStates until cleared when removed by CatalogJanitor.
2368    // Update its state in regionStates to it shows as offline and split when read
2369    // later figuring what regions are in a table and what are not: see
2370    // regionStates#getRegionsOfTable
2371    final RegionStateNode node = regionStates.getOrCreateRegionStateNode(parent);
2372    node.setState(State.SPLIT);
2373    final RegionStateNode nodeA = regionStates.getOrCreateRegionStateNode(daughterA);
2374    nodeA.setState(State.SPLITTING_NEW);
2375    final RegionStateNode nodeB = regionStates.getOrCreateRegionStateNode(daughterB);
2376    nodeB.setState(State.SPLITTING_NEW);
2377
2378    TableDescriptor td = master.getTableDescriptors().get(parent.getTable());
2379    // TODO: here we just update the parent region info in meta, to set split and offline to true,
2380    // without changing the one in the region node. This is a bit confusing but the region info
2381    // field in RegionStateNode is not expected to be changed in the current design. Need to find a
2382    // possible way to address this problem, or at least adding more comments about the trick to
2383    // deal with this problem, that when you want to filter out split parent, you need to check both
2384    // the RegionState on whether it is split, and also the region info. If one of them matches then
2385    // it is a split parent. And usually only one of them can match, as after restart, the region
2386    // state will be changed from SPLIT to CLOSED.
2387    regionStateStore.splitRegion(parent, daughterA, daughterB, serverName, td);
2388    regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(node);
2389    regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(nodeA);
2390    regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(nodeB);
2391    if (shouldAssignFavoredNodes(parent)) {
2392      List<ServerName> onlineServers = this.master.getServerManager().getOnlineServersList();
2393      getFavoredNodePromoter().generateFavoredNodesForDaughter(onlineServers, parent, daughterA,
2394        daughterB);
2395    }
2396  }
2397
2398  /**
2399   * When called here, the merge has happened. The merged regions have been unassigned and the above
2400   * markRegionClosed has been called on each so they have been disassociated from a hosting Server.
2401   * The merged region will be open after this call. The merged regions are removed from hbase:meta
2402   * below. Later they are deleted from the filesystem by the catalog janitor running against
2403   * hbase:meta. It notices when the merged region no longer holds references to the old regions
2404   * (References are deleted after a compaction rewrites what the Reference points at but not until
2405   * the archiver chore runs, are the References removed).
2406   */
2407  public void markRegionAsMerged(final RegionInfo child, final ServerName serverName,
2408    RegionInfo[] mergeParents) throws IOException {
2409    final RegionStateNode node = regionStates.getOrCreateRegionStateNode(child);
2410    for (RegionInfo ri : mergeParents) {
2411      regionStates.deleteRegion(ri);
2412      regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionDelete(ri);
2413    }
2414
2415    TableDescriptor td = master.getTableDescriptors().get(child.getTable());
2416    regionStateStore.mergeRegions(child, mergeParents, serverName, td);
2417    regionInTransitionTracker.handleRegionStateNodeOperation(node);
2418    if (shouldAssignFavoredNodes(child)) {
2419      getFavoredNodePromoter().generateFavoredNodesForMergedRegion(child, mergeParents);
2420    }
2421  }

2423  /*
2424   * Favored nodes should be applied only when FavoredNodes balancer is configured and the region
2425   * belongs to a non-system table.
2426   */
2427  private boolean shouldAssignFavoredNodes(RegionInfo region) {
2428    return this.shouldAssignRegionsWithFavoredNodes
2429      && FavoredNodesManager.isFavoredNodeApplicable(region);
2430  }

2432  // ============================================================================================
2433  // Assign Queue (Assign/Balance)
2434  // ============================================================================================
2435  private final ArrayList<RegionStateNode> pendingAssignQueue = new ArrayList<RegionStateNode>();
2436  private final ReentrantLock assignQueueLock = new ReentrantLock();
2437  private final Condition assignQueueFullCond = assignQueueLock.newCondition();
2438
2439  /**
2440   * Add the assign operation to the assignment queue. The pending assignment operation will be
2441   * processed, and each region will be assigned by a server using the balancer.
2442   */
2443  protected void queueAssign(final RegionStateNode regionNode) {
2444    regionNode.getProcedureEvent().suspend();
2445
2446    // TODO: quick-start for meta and the other sys-tables?
2447    assignQueueLock.lock();
2448    try {
2449      pendingAssignQueue.add(regionNode);
2450      if (
2451        regionNode.isSystemTable() || pendingAssignQueue.size() == 1
2452          || pendingAssignQueue.size() >= assignDispatchWaitQueueMaxSize
2453      ) {
2454        assignQueueFullCond.signal();
2455      }
2456    } finally {
2457      assignQueueLock.unlock();
2458    }
2459  }
2460
2461  private void startAssignmentThread() {
2462    assignThread = new Thread(master.getServerName().toShortString()) {
2463      @Override
2464      public void run() {
2465        while (isRunning()) {
2466          processAssignQueue();
2467        }
2468        pendingAssignQueue.clear();
2469      }
2470    };
2471    assignThread.setDaemon(true);
2472    assignThread.start();
2473  }
2474
2475  private void stopAssignmentThread() {
2476    assignQueueSignal();
2477    try {
2478      while (assignThread.isAlive()) {
2479        assignQueueSignal();
2480        assignThread.join(250);
2481      }
2482    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
2483      LOG.warn("join interrupted", e);
2484      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
2485    }
2486  }
2487
2488  private void assignQueueSignal() {
2489    assignQueueLock.lock();
2490    try {
2491      assignQueueFullCond.signal();
2492    } finally {
2493      assignQueueLock.unlock();
2494    }
2495  }
2496
2497  @edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.SuppressWarnings("WA_AWAIT_NOT_IN_LOOP")
2498  private HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> waitOnAssignQueue() {
2499    HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regions = null;
2500
2501    assignQueueLock.lock();
2502    try {
2503      if (pendingAssignQueue.isEmpty() && isRunning()) {
2504        assignQueueFullCond.await();
2505      }
2506
2507      if (!isRunning()) {
2508        return null;
2509      }
2510      assignQueueFullCond.await(assignDispatchWaitMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
2511      regions = new HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode>(pendingAssignQueue.size());
2512      for (RegionStateNode regionNode : pendingAssignQueue) {
2513        regions.put(regionNode.getRegionInfo(), regionNode);
2514      }
2515      pendingAssignQueue.clear();
2516    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
2517      LOG.warn("got interrupted ", e);
2518      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
2519    } finally {
2520      assignQueueLock.unlock();
2521    }
2522    return regions;
2523  }
2524
2525  private void processAssignQueue() {
2526    final HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regions = waitOnAssignQueue();
2527    if (regions == null || regions.size() == 0 || !isRunning()) {
2528      return;
2529    }
2530
2531    if (LOG.isTraceEnabled()) {
2532      LOG.trace("PROCESS ASSIGN QUEUE regionCount=" + regions.size());
2533    }
2534
2535    // TODO: Optimize balancer. pass a RegionPlan?
2536    final HashMap<RegionInfo, ServerName> retainMap = new HashMap<>();
2537    final List<RegionInfo> userHRIs = new ArrayList<>(regions.size());
2538    // Regions for system tables requiring reassignment
2539    final List<RegionInfo> systemHRIs = new ArrayList<>();
2540    for (RegionStateNode regionStateNode : regions.values()) {
2541      boolean sysTable = regionStateNode.isSystemTable();
2542      final List<RegionInfo> hris = sysTable ? systemHRIs : userHRIs;
2543      if (regionStateNode.getRegionLocation() != null) {
2544        retainMap.put(regionStateNode.getRegionInfo(), regionStateNode.getRegionLocation());
2545      } else {
2546        hris.add(regionStateNode.getRegionInfo());
2547      }
2548    }
2549
2550    // TODO: connect with the listener to invalidate the cache
2551
2552    // TODO use events
2553    List<ServerName> servers = master.getServerManager().createDestinationServersList();
2554    for (int i = 0; servers.size() < 1; ++i) {
2555      // Report every fourth time around this loop; try not to flood log.
2556      if (i % 4 == 0) {
2557        LOG.warn("No servers available; cannot place " + regions.size() + " unassigned regions.");
2558      }
2559
2560      if (!isRunning()) {
2561        LOG.debug("Stopped! Dropping assign of " + regions.size() + " queued regions.");
2562        return;
2563      }
2564      Threads.sleep(250);
2565      servers = master.getServerManager().createDestinationServersList();
2566    }
2567
2568    if (!systemHRIs.isEmpty()) {
2569      // System table regions requiring reassignment are present, get region servers
2570      // not available for system table regions
2571      final List<ServerName> excludeServers = getExcludedServersForSystemTable();
2572      List<ServerName> serversForSysTables =
2573        servers.stream().filter(s -> !excludeServers.contains(s)).collect(Collectors.toList());
2574      if (serversForSysTables.isEmpty()) {
2575        LOG.warn("Filtering old server versions and the excluded produced an empty set; "
2576          + "instead considering all candidate servers!");
2577      }
2578      LOG.debug("Processing assignQueue; systemServersCount=" + serversForSysTables.size()
2579        + ", allServersCount=" + servers.size());
2580      processAssignmentPlans(regions, null, systemHRIs,
2581        serversForSysTables.isEmpty() && !containsBogusAssignments(regions, systemHRIs)
2582          ? servers
2583          : serversForSysTables);
2584    }
2585
2586    processAssignmentPlans(regions, retainMap, userHRIs, servers);
2587  }
2588
2589  private boolean containsBogusAssignments(Map<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regions,
2590    List<RegionInfo> hirs) {
2591    for (RegionInfo ri : hirs) {
2592      if (
2593        regions.get(ri).getRegionLocation() != null
2594          && regions.get(ri).getRegionLocation().equals(LoadBalancer.BOGUS_SERVER_NAME)
2595      ) {
2596        return true;
2597      }
2598    }
2599    return false;
2600  }
2601
2602  private void processAssignmentPlans(final HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regions,
2603    final HashMap<RegionInfo, ServerName> retainMap, final List<RegionInfo> hris,
2604    final List<ServerName> servers) {
2605    boolean isTraceEnabled = LOG.isTraceEnabled();
2606    if (isTraceEnabled) {
2607      LOG.trace("Available servers count=" + servers.size() + ": " + servers);
2608    }
2609
2610    final LoadBalancer balancer = getBalancer();
2611    // ask the balancer where to place regions
2612    if (retainMap != null && !retainMap.isEmpty()) {
2613      if (isTraceEnabled) {
2614        LOG.trace("retain assign regions=" + retainMap);
2615      }
2616      try {
2617        acceptPlan(regions, balancer.retainAssignment(retainMap, servers));
2618      } catch (IOException e) {
2619        LOG.warn("unable to retain assignment", e);
2620        addToPendingAssignment(regions, retainMap.keySet());
2621      }
2622    }
2623
2624    // TODO: Do we need to split retain and round-robin?
2625    // the retain seems to fallback to round-robin/random if the region is not in the map.
2626    if (!hris.isEmpty()) {
2627      Collections.sort(hris, RegionInfo.COMPARATOR);
2628      if (isTraceEnabled) {
2629        LOG.trace("round robin regions=" + hris);
2630      }
2631      try {
2632        acceptPlan(regions, balancer.roundRobinAssignment(hris, servers));
2633      } catch (IOException e) {
2634        LOG.warn("unable to round-robin assignment", e);
2635        addToPendingAssignment(regions, hris);
2636      }
2637    }
2638  }
2639
2640  private void acceptPlan(final HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regions,
2641    final Map<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> plan) throws HBaseIOException {
2642    final ProcedureEvent<?>[] events = new ProcedureEvent[regions.size()];
2643    final long st = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
2644
2645    if (plan.isEmpty()) {
2646      throw new HBaseIOException("unable to compute plans for regions=" + regions.size());
2647    }
2648
2649    int evcount = 0;
2650    for (Map.Entry<ServerName, List<RegionInfo>> entry : plan.entrySet()) {
2651      final ServerName server = entry.getKey();
2652      for (RegionInfo hri : entry.getValue()) {
2653        final RegionStateNode regionNode = regions.get(hri);
2654        regionNode.setRegionLocation(server);
2655        if (server.equals(LoadBalancer.BOGUS_SERVER_NAME) && regionNode.isSystemTable()) {
2656          assignQueueLock.lock();
2657          try {
2658            pendingAssignQueue.add(regionNode);
2659          } finally {
2660            assignQueueLock.unlock();
2661          }
2662        } else {
2663          events[evcount++] = regionNode.getProcedureEvent();
2664        }
2665      }
2666    }
2667    ProcedureEvent.wakeEvents(getProcedureScheduler(), events);
2668
2669    final long et = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
2670    if (LOG.isTraceEnabled()) {
2671      LOG.trace("ASSIGN ACCEPT " + events.length + " -> " + StringUtils.humanTimeDiff(et - st));
2672    }
2673  }
2674
2675  private void addToPendingAssignment(final HashMap<RegionInfo, RegionStateNode> regions,
2676    final Collection<RegionInfo> pendingRegions) {
2677    assignQueueLock.lock();
2678    try {
2679      for (RegionInfo hri : pendingRegions) {
2680        pendingAssignQueue.add(regions.get(hri));
2681      }
2682    } finally {
2683      assignQueueLock.unlock();
2684    }
2685  }
2686
2687  /**
2688   * For a given cluster with mixed versions of servers, get a list of servers with lower versions,
2689   * where system table regions should not be assigned to. For system table, we must assign regions
2690   * to a server with highest version. However, we can disable this exclusion using config:
2691   * "hbase.min.version.move.system.tables" if checkForMinVersion is true. Detailed explanation
2692   * available with definition of minVersionToMoveSysTables.
2693   * @return List of Excluded servers for System table regions.
2694   */
2695  public List<ServerName> getExcludedServersForSystemTable() {
2696    // TODO: This should be a cached list kept by the ServerManager rather than calculated on each
2697    // move or system region assign. The RegionServerTracker keeps list of online Servers with
2698    // RegionServerInfo that includes Version.
2699    List<Pair<ServerName, String>> serverList =
2700      master.getServerManager().getOnlineServersList().stream()
2701        .map(s -> new Pair<>(s, master.getRegionServerVersion(s))).collect(Collectors.toList());
2702    if (serverList.isEmpty()) {
2703      return new ArrayList<>();
2704    }
2705    String highestVersion = Collections
2706      .max(serverList, (o1, o2) -> VersionInfo.compareVersion(o1.getSecond(), o2.getSecond()))
2707      .getSecond();
2708    if (!DEFAULT_MIN_VERSION_MOVE_SYS_TABLES_CONFIG.equals(minVersionToMoveSysTables)) {
2709      int comparedValue = VersionInfo.compareVersion(minVersionToMoveSysTables, highestVersion);
2710      if (comparedValue > 0) {
2711        return new ArrayList<>();
2712      }
2713    }
2714    return serverList.stream().filter(pair -> !pair.getSecond().equals(highestVersion))
2715      .map(Pair::getFirst).collect(Collectors.toList());
2716  }

2722  /** Returns a snapshot of rsReports */
2723  public Map<ServerName, Set<byte[]>> getRSReports() {
2724    Map<ServerName, Set<byte[]>> rsReportsSnapshot = new HashMap<>();
2725    synchronized (rsReports) {
2726      rsReports.entrySet().forEach(e -> rsReportsSnapshot.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
2727    }
2728    return rsReportsSnapshot;
2729  }

2731  /**
2732   * Provide regions state count for given table. e.g howmany regions of give table are
2733   * opened/closed/rit etc
2734   * @param tableName TableName
2735   * @return region states count
2736   */
2737  public RegionStatesCount getRegionStatesCount(TableName tableName) {
2738    int openRegionsCount = 0;
2739    int closedRegionCount = 0;
2740    int ritCount = 0;
2741    int splitRegionCount = 0;
2742    int totalRegionCount = 0;
2743    if (!isTableDisabled(tableName)) {
2744      final List<RegionState> states = regionStates.getTableRegionStates(tableName);
2745      for (RegionState regionState : states) {
2746        if (regionState.isOpened()) {
2747          openRegionsCount++;
2748        } else if (regionState.isClosed()) {
2749          closedRegionCount++;
2750        } else if (regionState.isSplit()) {
2751          splitRegionCount++;
2752        }
2753      }
2754      totalRegionCount = states.size();
2755      ritCount = totalRegionCount - openRegionsCount - splitRegionCount;
2756    }
2757    return new RegionStatesCount.RegionStatesCountBuilder().setOpenRegions(openRegionsCount)
2758      .setClosedRegions(closedRegionCount).setSplitRegions(splitRegionCount)
2759      .setRegionsInTransition(ritCount).setTotalRegions(totalRegionCount).build();
2760  }
